Commentary.Commentary: Will we? Won't we? In a normal world, this should have been the 4th ODI of this series. But with as many 4 players from the UAE testing positive for Covid, we have got into a tangle with the second ODI first being postponed and then on a later date, cancelled. We are still awaiting the final decision of the two boards and hope that the series goes ahead with 2 ODIs left. Now, moving to the cricket played, yes. You are reading it right. UAE are 1-0 up in this ODI series. Who would have thought? After losing 6 on the trot, the Emiratis finally pulled off a win for the first time in this format, over Ireland. It was an intriguing game, which saw three centuries and nothing much for the bowlers. The side which had more centurions won and rightly so. UAE were in the doldrums at 51/3, chasing 270 but two experienced personnel in Chundangapoyil Rizwan and Muhammad Usman bailed them out with a big stand. Having said that, one feels that Ireland were not attacking. They seemed to be more content with giving opportunities to new players, rather than putting up their best bowlers upfront. Still, they would believe that should have won. The fielding was disappointing with catches going down and run outs being missed. Expect more experimentation from the Irish come Thursday but one can definitely look for an improved display. As far as the UAE are concerned, they will be revelling with their win but it was not just due to two individuals. They bowled brilliantly as well and stifled Ireland in the middle overs. They will be looking to do the basics right.
